List the projects in the projects directory.

--size adds the disk space each project takes (its folder, settings, allowlist and env folder). It reads every file in them, which can take a while for large projects.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower projects list [flags]
```

Also available as `codeflower projects ls`.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--size` |  | also show the disk space each project takes (slow for large projects) |

## Inherited flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory with config.yaml (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--env-dir string` |  | folder of the projects' env folders, for projects whose settings do not name one (or env_dir in the config) |
| `--projects-dir string` |  | folder of the projects started with --project (or projects_dir in the config; default ~/codeflower/projects) |
